name: Replace an order item's design file through the Open API
user_goal: As an Open API integrator (token with orders:write), replace the design file of an existing order item artwork programmatically — the same in-place 'Replace design' the merchant can do in the Portal — without changing which artwork/customization/print area the item is linked to.
stable_since_version_note: Feature mới, endpoint chỉ có trên staging, chưa lên production tại 2026-10-11 (KB-025); chưa có version ổn định.

actors.role: Open API client (token with orders:write ability)
actors.permission_observed: Endpoint POST openapi/v1/order-item-artworks/{order_item_artwork_id}/design is gated by the existing orders:write ability (dev writeup, OBSERVED_CURRENT). Only resources belonging to the caller's account are reachable: another account's order item artwork returns 404. No token WITHOUT orders:write has been described or exercised, so the rejection behaviour at the ability boundary is unknown.

actors.role: Open API client (token with orders:read ability)
actors.permission_observed: Calls GET /openapi/v1/orders/{order_id} to discover print_areas[].id per line item before calling replace design. Ability scope stated in KB scope only; not exercised as a boundary.

entry_points.precondition: Order exists in the caller's account and has a line item with a print area. Dev guidance: call this before replace design.

Token has orders:write; order_item_artwork_id exists and belongs to the caller's account; target order item currently in READY (status value 2); request provides file or url. That print_areas[].id IS the order_item_artwork_id is INFERRED only (KB-037).

capabilities.name: Discover the order_item_artwork_id to target
capabilities.description: GET /openapi/v1/orders/{order_id} already returns print_areas[].id for each line item with no special flag (OBSERVED_CURRENT, dev writeup). That this print_areas[].id is the order_item_artwork_id used by the replace endpoint is INFERRED from the doc section heading and CCR narrative only (LOW).

capabilities.name: Replace the design file of an order item artwork in place
capabilities.description: POST openapi/v1/order-item-artworks/{order_item_artwork_id}/design mirrors the Portal 'Replace design' action (same upload/storage logic): only the file changes in place; artwork_id, customization_id and printarea_id stay unchanged (OBSERVED_CURRENT). Scope is Replace design only — Add new design is out of scope (OBSERVED_CURRENT). INFERRED (LOW, CCR narrative only): input is multipart field `file` OR JSON {"url": ...} fetched server-side; 200 returns the full order-item-artwork object; the new file overwrites the same storage path so callers may append ?v={random} to bypass cache; fulfillment status of the order is not changed.

capabilities.name: Reject replace requests that fail ownership, item-state or input guards
capabilities.description: 404 when the order item artwork does not exist or does not belong to the caller's account; 422 when the order item is not READY (2); 422 when neither file nor url is provided (all OBSERVED_CURRENT, status codes only, no response body/message captured). INFERRED (LOW): the READY precondition is intentionally stricter than the Portal, where Replace design on a non-READY item only warns and lets the user continue — Portal behaviour itself not observed in this KB.

state_transitions.from: order item artwork with current design file (order item READY, status 2)
state_transitions.to: same order item artwork with new design file; artwork_id/customization_id/printarea_id unchanged
state_transitions.condition: token has orders:write; artwork belongs to caller's account; item READY. Effect on order fulfillment status INFERRED unchanged (KB-034); resulting app-side order status unknown (see unknown_areas).
item status at call time is not READY

state_transitions.from: order_item_artwork_id not existing or owned by another account
state_transitions.condition: artwork not found in caller's account

state_transitions.from: order item READY, request without file and without url

observed_behavior.statement: Open API exposes POST openapi/v1/order-item-artworks/{order_item_artwork_id}/design, gated by the existing orders:write ability; available on staging, not on production as of 2026-10-11.
Replace design via Open API mirrors Portal 'Replace design' (same upload/storage logic): only the file changes in place; artwork_id/customization_id/printarea_id are untouched.
Target order item must be READY (status value 2) at call time, otherwise 422.
404 when the order item artwork does not exist or does not belong to the caller's account.
422 when neither file nor url is provided.
Endpoint scope is Replace design only; Add new design is not covered.
GET /openapi/v1/orders/{order_id} returns print_areas[].id per line item without any special flag.
Input is multipart `file` OR JSON {"url": ...} (server fetches the URL).
Success returns 200 with the full order-item-artwork object (url, thumbnail, width/height, processing_at/processed_at, order_item, printarea, artwork, customization).
New file overwrites the same path as the old file; callers may append ?v={random} to bypass cache.
Replace design via this endpoint does not change the order's fulfillment status.
The READY precondition is intentionally stricter than Portal Replace design (Portal only warns on non-READY item and continues).
print_areas[].id from GET order is the order_item_artwork_id for the replace endpoint.

observed_validations_note: Không có message nguyên văn hay observed_count nào trong KB (chỉ có status code 404/422 từ dev writeup, observed_count = null), nên không ghi observed_validation; các điều kiện từ chối nằm ở observed_behavior/state_transitions.

limitations.statement: Endpoint covers Replace design only, not Add new design.
Endpoint is staging-only (not shipped to production) as of 2026-10-11.

permissions.role: Open API client (token with orders:write ability)
permissions.note: Required ability for replace design. Account isolation: only the caller's own order item artworks are reachable (other account -> 404). Behaviour for a token lacking orders:write not described.

permissions.role: Open API client (token with orders:read ability)
permissions.note: Used for GET /openapi/v1/orders/{order_id} to discover print_areas[].id.

portal.item: Portal 'Replace design' action (parity reference only — mirrored by the API; Portal behaviour itself not observed in this KB)

data.item: order item artwork: artwork_id / customization_id / printarea_id preserved, design file replaced in place at same storage path (path overwrite INFERRED)
order item status READY = 2 (item-level status, distinct from order-level status)

code.item: PR qikify/teeinblue-api#3910 (referenced by dev writeup TIB-5506; code not inspected)

dependencies.statement: Requires an order item in READY (status 2). Order items carry their own status independent of the order-level status, so READY here is the item-level status.
Reuses the Portal 'Replace design' upload/storage logic — a regression in the Portal replace path likely affects this endpoint and vice versa.
Caller needs the order_item_artwork_id, discoverable via GET /openapi/v1/orders/{order_id} (mapping INFERRED).

risks.risk: Oracles are not confirmed expected: every behaviour is OBSERVED_CURRENT from a dev writeup (downgraded by product policy) or INFERRED from CCR narrative. Checklist expected results built from this profile need PO confirmation.
Replacing a design on an item that is READY but already sent to fulfillment could change a file already handed to production; behaviour unverified.
Server-side URL fetch with undefined rules (timeout, redirect, content-type, private IP) is a potential SSRF surface.
Overwrite at the same storage path means cached consumers may keep serving the old design unless cache-busted.

unknown_areas.question: What is the app-side order status value after a replace design via Open API? The ticket only says it is 'set to a different value'.
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: KB-034 only infers fulfillment status is unchanged; without the concrete app-side status, a check after replace has no oracle and a status side effect could go unnoticed.

unknown_areas.question: What file validation does the endpoint apply (file type, max size, dimension/aspect ratio vs print area)?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: No rule is described; the sample accepting 900x1345 on a 1400x1400 print area is NOT an approved rule, so negative-input checks have no expected result.

unknown_areas.question: What are the URL fetch rules when JSON url is sent (timeout, redirect, content-type, blocking private IP/SSRF)?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Server-side fetch of caller-supplied URLs is a security surface; without defined rules it cannot be tested or judged.

unknown_areas.question: What happens when a request sends both file and url?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Only the 'neither' case (422) is described; precedence or rejection for 'both' is undefined, so no oracle exists.

unknown_areas.question: What happens when the order item is READY but has already been sent to fulfillment?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: The READY precondition alone would allow the call; replacing a file already handed to fulfillment may cause a wrong print. State could not be set up on staging.

unknown_areas.question: Bad input (URL 404 or not an image, malformed id) was reported by QA to return 500 with internal details (SQL/stack/nginx) on staging — what is the intended error response?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Suspected bug excluded from canon (no KB item, no captured artifact); must not be used as expected, but checklist needs to know this area has no oracle and a possible information-leak defect.
unknown_areas.kb_refs_note: Không có KB item (normalizer đưa vào unmapped_evidence); gap trace về shard qua OQ draft.

unknown_areas.question: What does the endpoint return for a token that lacks the orders:write ability (403, 401, 404)?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: KB-025 states the ability gate but only 404/422 error responses are described; the permission boundary itself has no oracle.

unknown_areas.question: What is the response body / error message for the 404 and 422 rejections?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Only status codes are known; clients and checks cannot distinguish 'not READY' from 'no file nor url' (both 422) without the body.

unknown_areas.question: What does Portal 'Replace design' actually do for a non-READY item (warn and continue?), and do both paths produce the same stored result for a READY item?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Parity with Portal is claimed (KB-026) and the stricter API precondition is only inferred (KB-035); Portal behaviour is not observed in this KB.
